source.title: On some generalizations of outerplanar graphs: Results and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 4008413. Local workflow shard metadata and exact-title search metadata identify the exact work as Maciej M. Syslo, "On some generalizations of outerplanar graphs: Results and open problems," WG 1986, Lecture Notes in Computer Science volume 246, pages 146-164, 1987, DOI 10.1007/3-540-17218-1_56.

failure_mode=paywalled_or_restricted. Local shell fetching of https://zbmath.org/4008413 and https://api.zbmath.org/document/4008413 could not resolve zbMATH hosts in the restricted CLI environment. Browser/page reading did not expose a readable zbMATH record body for the exact URL. The Springer chapter page for the recovered DOI exposes only bibliographic metadata, the abstract, references, and a subscription-access notice, not the full problem statements.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by exact title, exact title plus PDF, DOI 10.1007/3-540-17218-1_56 plus PDF, and the zbMATH identifier 4008413. Candidate pages inspected or surfaced included DBLP, Springer Link, DOI/Springer endpoints, DML/EUDML reference pages, a later Russian article citing the work, and unrelated theses or citing pages. These were rejected because they were resolver metadata, citation/reference-only pages, subscription previews, or different works, and none provided a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact containing the problem statements.

No readable primary source artifact was recovered. The workflow forbids extracting questions from zbMATH/local shard metadata, abstracts, bibliographic records, search snippets, citation pages, or related papers, so the run returns error_input with no accepted questions.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/4008413.json and outputs/latest.json.
